description: Synthetic Carbon Capture Storage Measurement Reporting and Verification Dataset (SCCS-MRV) is a data set described in the paper "Synthetic Carbon Capture Storage Measurement Reporting and Verification Dataset (SCCS-MRV)" in IEEE Data Descriptions (IEEE, 2026), produced by Sreekanth Muktevi, Yogesh Nagpal, Rajesh Leela and colleagues. This article introduces the Synthetic Carbon Capture Storage Measurement Reporting and Verification dataset (SCCS-OFPOSDU), the first publicly available synthetic dataset designed to support carbon capture and storage (CCS) measurement, reporting, and verification (MRV) workflows. The dataset simulates the capture–transport–injection–storage–monitoring chain, providing daily, monthly, and annual records for synthetic facilities across multiple reservoir types. Coverage: synthetic carbon capture and storage sites. The data are held on Zenodo, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost: free of charge according to the repository record; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support carbon capture and storage monitoring and reporting workflows. Related record: the journal-level record for IEEE Data Descriptions.
